answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41682 Country: India Title: Fasting on Friday other than ramadan Question: Someone says fasting on Friday is makrooh as Friday is considered as an Eid day in Islam. Is this correct? Answer ID: 41682 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1435/1435/M=1433) Hadith stops only from keeping fast on Friday. If someone wants to keep fast on Friday then he should add one day before or after it. It is not a valid reason that it is makrooh to keep fast on Friday due to resemblance of Eid day. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
